searchText: <@466006586477772831> <@159152274659082240> hi guys! Is it possible that I can run a local devnet with a single node, say lighthouse+geth with the repo eip4844-interop? what changes should I make if possible? Yeah we were writing a guide to do so 😄 I'd recommend getting up to speed with kurtosis for a small local devnet. wait till EoD for this without bugs: https://notes.ethereum.org/@parithosh/kurtosis-example or try it now with potential bugs (images are old!!!) Good to know! thank you guys! wonderful tool! a question: how can I fund/prefund an address? Its already pre-funded 🙂 You can just use the default privkeys: https://github.com/kurtosis-tech/eth-network-package/blob/9295b3997aef6678f670d5d99c5ca7e6ff64d281/src/prelaunch_data_generator/genesis_constants/genesis_constants.star#L4 Lovely! And you saved my day!👍
